Duniyadari | Ep. 1763 | 18th November, 2026
In today's episode, Nikita Agarwal talks about a string of recent technology outages across the United States, including disruptions at Microsoft, Apple, major banks, airlines and even parts of government communications networks, that has revived concerns about the fragility of the digital infrastructure that powers modern life. Against this backdrop, social media speculation about a possible 90-day blackout gained traction, linking these failures to fears of a large scale cyberattack or systemic collapse.
